status.summary: Former UFC women's flyweight champion, now on a two-fight win streak. She won the belt from Valentina Shevchenko by rear-naked choke at UFC 285 (Mar 4, 2023), kept it with a split draw in the rematch (Sep 16, 2023), and lost it 45-50 x3 at UFC 306 (Sep 14, 2024). After a 27-30 x3 loss to Natalia Silva (UFC 315, May 10, 2025) she knocked out Maycee Barber at 2:42 of R1 (Mar 28, 2026, Seattle). She then beat Manon Fiorot 29-28 x3 at Noche UFC (Sep 12, 2026, Glendale), scoring a knockdown in R1. The dataset has Silva winning a women's flyweight title bout over Wang Cong at UFC 332 (Oct 3, 2026). Grasso's ranking, next booking and any injuries could not be checked on the web this session.

style.summary: A boxer who has never been knocked down in the UFC. She works behind punching combinations, adds low kicks, and grabs the back when an opponent turns or overcommits, as Shevchenko did at UFC 285. Her weak points are wrestling and output. A strong wrestler can hold her down for long spells, and a sharper volume striker can beat her on points.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 79.2% head, 8.8% body, 12.1% legs (landed 67.4/13.3/19.3); career attempts 77.4/11.2/11.4; women's flyweight league 77.3/14.0/8.7. She kicks the legs more than the division and goes to the body less. No web scouting source could be read this session, so the split inside each group is a judgment from her boxing profile: jab and straight lead, then hooks, with head kicks rare. Calf vs inside cannot be told apart in ufcstats, so legs are split evenly. knee 0.05 and elbow 0.03 reflect clinch work (15% of career landed strikes in the clinch vs 11% for the division; 31 of 35 in the 2023 Shevchenko rematch), which ufcstats does not split by technique. Medium-low confidence.
